easy.formula: unit cubes in an n-cube with one face layer removed = n^3 - n^2
saving from using lp - 1 instead of lp l/100 km = km pl / 100
minute of the hour on arrival after hh:mm plus sp minutes = (mm + sp) mod 60
empty seats = cap ceil(pax / cap) - pax

hard.formula: four walls = 2 ht (wd + ln)
walls + ceiling = 2 ht (wd + ln) + wd ln
open-top box = wd ln + 2 ht wd + 2 ht ln
space diagonal squared = wd^2 + ln^2 + ht^2
two cube crates = wd^3 + ht^3
room air minus a cube cabinet of side ht = wd ln ht - ht^3
square pyramid = wd^2 ht / 3
wedge (half box) = wd ln ht / 2
box frame edges = 4 (wd + ln + ht)
floor wd^2 plus a wd x ht strip, quartered = (wd^2 + wd ht) / 4
path of width pc around pa x pb = (pa + 2pc)(pb + 2pc) - pa pb
fence around the path = 2(pa + pb) + 8 pc
slab pa x pb, pc quarter-units thick = pa pb pc / 4
square bed pa^2 plus square bed pb^2 minus a pc^2 corner
hollow cube side pa, wall 1 = pa^3 - (pa - 2)^3 (pa > 2)
cannonballs in a triangular pyramid = n(n+1)(n+2)/6
pentagonal number = n(3n - 1)/2
star number = 6n(n - 1) + 1
squares of every size on an n x n board (= n(n+1)(2n+1)/6) minus the n^2 unit squares
games in rd round-robins of nt teams = rd nt(nt-1)/2
handshakes between players of different teams = rd^2 nt(nt-1)/2
points available, 3 per game, home and away = 3 nt(nt-1) rd
rd groups of nt teams round-robin, then a knockout of rd = rd nt(nt-1)/2 + rd - 1
percent of possible points = 100 (3wn + dr) / (3 (wn + dr + ls))
win percent with draws as halves = 100 (2wn + dr) / (2 (wn + dr + ls))
points dropped = 3 (dr + ls) - dr = 2 dr + 3 ls
fuel cost = km lp pl / 100
return trip fuel cost = 2 km lp pl / 100
fuel cost plus a toll of lp per 100 km = km lp pl / 100 + km lp / 100
litres for km out at lp and back at lp + 2 = km lp / 100 + km (lp + 2) / 100
adults full fare, children half = ad fr + ch fr / 2
a quarter off for everyone = 3 (ad + ch) fr / 4
return trip, children half = fr (2 ad + ch)
children a third off = ad fr + 2 ch fr / 3
distance at sp per hour for hh:mm = sp (60 hh + mm) / 60
minutes for a round trip of hh:mm each way plus a 30 min stop = 2(60 hh + mm) + sx/2
hours elapsed when leaving at hh:mm and travelling sp minutes = hh + (mm + sp) div 60
hire cost = hire ceil(pax / cap)
passengers in the last vehicle = (pax - 1) mod cap + 1
hire cost per passenger, rounded down = hire ceil(pax / cap) div pax
